hints.title: Nested Bracket Obstacle
hints.text: Repeatedly removing adjacent matching pairs takes quadratic time. When a closing bracket appears, which earlier bracket must it match, and what would you need to have kept to find it immediately?

hints.title: Stack Invariant and Delimiter Map
hints.text: Maintain a stack to store opening brackets awaiting their counterparts, paired with a mapping from each closing bracket to its expected opening bracket.

hints.title: Push on Open, Match on Close
hints.text: Iterate through each character. If it is an opening delimiter, push it onto the stack. If it is a closing delimiter, check that the stack is not empty and pop the top element, verifying it matches the opening counterpart. After processing all characters, verify that the stack is completely empty.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of string s (1 <= N <= 10^4)
complexity.notes: Single pass pushing and popping each character from stack at most once.

solutions.approach: LIFO Stack Matching with Delimiter Mapping
